_comment: Exact versions of the libraries a React preview may import. build.mjs installs them into a scratch folder, bundles them into ../vendor and records each file's sha256 in ../vendor/manifest.json. Not a package manifest on purpose: these are browser code the box serves, not dependencies of the server.

tarballs._comment: SheetJS publishes 0.20.x only from its own site; npm stops at 0.18.5, which has known prototype-pollution and ReDoS flaws. The tarball is committed here (taken from SheetJS's release page for 0.20.3) and build.mjs installs it only if its sha256 matches.
